Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I read the whole diff and checked the current laws from upstream/main.

The fitted arcs retain the analytic kerf and cover checks. The model verifier states its chord allowance. The tests check circle centres, offset radii, straight-side joints, polygon fallback, and the refusal of an inside radius below the kerf offset.

### Local build and tests

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4019`. No GitHub runner was used.

- PR head: `a7a32e421c4eca96459da0015e720d71efc370a3`.
- Base: `9caa0d572b43cd9936422bc4600d5fab7a059701` (`upstream/main`).
- Trial merge: `1a80244a8c0df3fcbac5dc43ec4904b83cb823d4`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge was clean.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 185 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled; 18.9 minutes |
| Quick test totals | 2,367 passed; 0 failed; 49 ignored |
| sim / motion / app unit suites | 266 / 684 / 311 passed |
| New motion model-arc tests | All 11 passed |
| `wire_post` | 22 passed, including all four new model-arc tests |
| `wire_verify` / `wire_verify_tol` | 3 / 2 passed |
| `golden_cl` / `solid_law_goldens` | 34 / 7 passed |
| `example_catalog` | 43 passed; 4 ignored |
| `example_catalog_adaptive` / `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 / 1 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps; 11 tests passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled |
| Clippy: motion, sim, app, `--all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The ignored tests kept their normal gate selection. Full heavy lanes were not required for this P6 change.

### Extra suites run

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sodick_wire_post --test g_edm_post`: 8 Sodick tests and 9 G-EDM tests passed. Both posted goldens matched.
- No fixture or importer file changed. The extra fixture and kernel STEP selection rules did not apply.

### Mutations

I also ran `wire_edm::model_arcs_tests::the_laws_judge_the_read_arcs_and_catch_a_2_um_mutation` separately with `--exact`.

1. The original arc path passed the kerf check. A 2 um outward shift was refused as a burn into the product.
2. Replacing the arc moves with chords was refused by the cover check.

Both rejection assertions passed. No source change was needed for these checks.

### Goldens moved

None. No recorded NC or CL program changed in the diff. The selected CL and posted golden checks passed without regeneration.

### Requested before merge

None.

No UI file changed. No new dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed. No physical EDM machine or control was tested.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build cache warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Left for the maintainer: feat PR (feat(wire): arcs on model-based wire paths, P6) - waiting for the cut. Clean review at head a7a32e42 (mkinney, SAFETY-tier, no blocking findings, 2,367 passed + light lane 6/6); MERGEABLE. The review agent is still in flight (worktree kept to keep the build cache warm). Maintainer merges by hand.

merge-ready: clean review (full evidence in the review comment above) and MERGEABLE. needs-rework / conflicts / needs-maintainer removed; the PR is our own and is not a draft. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
